actions.targets: Selected plan-bound Homebrew/npm/pnpm packages
actions.inspect: Fresh app scan and plan
actions.plan: Saved plan plus exact --only targets and lifecycle-script policy
actions.apply: Run rendered package-manager commands under the declared runtime and script boundary
actions.verify: Bundle/command/source/version checks
actions.backup_rollback: Package-manager uninstall or component rollback
actions.interruption: No success record; inspect package state before retry
actions.idempotency: Repeat renders the same package-manager command sequence

actions.targets: Guard-reported iCloud placeholders only
actions.inspect: iCloud Git guard findings
actions.plan: Exact materialization path list
actions.apply: Request local materialization
actions.verify: Reinspect flags and Git readability
actions.backup_rollback: No deletion or eviction is performed
actions.interruption: Reinspect remaining dataless paths
actions.idempotency: Already-local paths remain unchanged

actions.targets: Unavailable legacy state source paths
actions.inspect: Source flags
actions.plan: Exact unavailable path list
actions.apply: Materialize source paths
actions.verify: Source readiness check
actions.backup_rollback: No source deletion
actions.interruption: Reinspect source flags
actions.idempotency: Already-local paths are unchanged

actions.targets: Legacy state files to machine-local destination
actions.inspect: Source availability and conflicts
actions.plan: File count, bytes, and destination
actions.apply: Copy through temporary files
actions.verify: SHA-256 every destination
actions.backup_rollback: Source remains intact
actions.interruption: Remove/ignore temporary files and reinspect
actions.idempotency: Matching destination files are skipped

actions.targets: Manifest-bound verified legacy source files
actions.inspect: Rehash source and destination
actions.plan: Exact removable files and bytes
actions.apply: Delete manifest-bound source files only
actions.verify: Report removed and preserved unknown files
actions.record: Cleanup result plus retained migration manifest
actions.backup_rollback: Verified destination is the recovery copy
actions.interruption: Reinspect both sides before retry
actions.idempotency: Missing already-cleaned source files are skipped

actions.targets: Allowlisted tracked defaults keys
actions.inspect: Current allowlisted preference scan
actions.plan: Private desired-values diff
actions.apply: defaults write and restart Finder/Dock
actions.verify: --check read-back
actions.backup_rollback: Previous scan supplies manual rollback values
actions.interruption: Rerun --check before retry
actions.idempotency: Writing the same scalar values converges

actions.targets: /Applications/Capacities.app only
actions.inspect: Bundle existence and preserved support paths
actions.plan: App-only removal preview
actions.apply: Remove app bundle
actions.verify: Bundle no longer exists and support paths remain
actions.backup_rollback: Reinstall app; support data is preserved
actions.interruption: Reinspect bundle and support paths
actions.idempotency: Absent bundle is a no-op

actions.targets: Claude rootfs.img and sessiondata.img
actions.inspect: VM report and active processes
actions.plan: Exact image paths and bytes
actions.apply: Delete images
actions.verify: Report remaining bundle bytes
actions.backup_rollback: Claude may rebuild images; no session recovery promised
actions.interruption: Reinspect VM bundle
actions.idempotency: Absent images are skipped

actions.targets: Claude claudevm.bundle
actions.inspect: VM report and active processes
actions.plan: Bundle path and bytes
actions.apply: Remove bundle
actions.verify: Bundle existence false
actions.backup_rollback: Claude may rebuild bundle
actions.interruption: Reinspect VM bundle
actions.idempotency: Absent bundle is a no-op

actions.targets: Claude vm_bundles directory flags and mode
actions.inspect: Process and lock-state report
actions.plan: Exact directory
actions.apply: chmod and immutable flag
actions.verify: Read directory flags
actions.backup_rollback: Run unlock
actions.interruption: Inspect mode and flags before retry
actions.idempotency: Repeated lock converges

actions.targets: Claude vm_bundles directory flags and mode
actions.inspect: Lock-state report
actions.plan: Exact directory
actions.apply: Clear immutable flag and restore mode
actions.verify: Read directory flags
actions.backup_rollback: Run lock with exact confirmation
actions.interruption: Inspect mode and flags
actions.idempotency: Repeated unlock converges

actions.targets: Docker Desktop-local data paths from inspect
actions.inspect: Processes, OrbStack, Docker context, and target sizes
actions.plan: Exact target paths and total bytes
actions.apply: Remove inspected Docker Desktop paths
actions.verify: Postflight inspect
actions.backup_rollback: No data rollback; reinstall app only
actions.interruption: Stop and run inspect; never force residual paths
actions.idempotency: Absent targets are skipped

actions.targets: Known standalone OpenClaw paths
actions.inspect: Commands, packages, paths, and sizes
actions.plan: Exact known existing paths
actions.apply: Remove known paths
actions.verify: Rediscover paths
actions.backup_rollback: No automatic rollback; Hermes/Kimi data preserved
actions.interruption: Rediscover before retry
actions.idempotency: Absent paths are skipped

actions.targets: Listed TCC service/client pairs only
actions.inspect: Latest permission state and candidates
actions.plan: Printed exact service/client rows
actions.apply: tccutil reset named pairs
actions.verify: Rerun permission-dependent workflow
actions.backup_rollback: macOS prompts again when capability is used
actions.interruption: Rerun permission inventory
actions.idempotency: Resetting an absent row remains safe

actions.targets: Allowlisted dotfile destinations
actions.inspect: Source and destination status
actions.plan: Exact link/backup actions
actions.apply: Backup conflicts and create symlinks
actions.verify: Read symlink targets
actions.backup_rollback: Timestamped backup for replaced files
actions.interruption: Inspect each destination
actions.idempotency: Correct existing symlinks are unchanged

actions.targets: Weekly drift LaunchAgent plist
actions.inspect: LaunchAgent status
actions.plan: Rendered plist and destination
actions.apply: Write and bootstrap LaunchAgent
actions.verify: launchctl print
actions.backup_rollback: Run uninstall
actions.interruption: Inspect plist and launchctl separately
actions.idempotency: Existing matching registration converges

actions.targets: Weekly drift LaunchAgent plist and registration
actions.inspect: LaunchAgent status
actions.plan: Exact destination
actions.apply: Bootout and timestamped rename
actions.verify: Registration absent and backup exists
actions.backup_rollback: Restore timestamped plist and bootstrap
actions.interruption: Inspect registration and both paths
actions.idempotency: Not-installed state is a no-op

actions.targets: Skill-created LaunchAgents, support paths, and managed symlinks
actions.inspect: Footprint inventory
actions.plan: Exact paths; logs optional
actions.apply: Bootout and timestamped backup/remove
actions.verify: Re-run footprint inventory
actions.backup_rollback: Timestamped backups where supported
actions.interruption: Reinventory before retry
actions.idempotency: Absent targets and non-managed links are skipped

actions.targets: User-selected Login Items or ~/Library/LaunchAgents only
actions.inspect: Numbered startup-item scan
actions.plan: Printed selected rows
actions.apply: Delete Login Item or bootout and rename plist
actions.verify: Re-run scan
actions.backup_rollback: Disabled plist is retained with .disabled suffix
actions.interruption: Re-run scan before selecting again
actions.idempotency: Already-disabled rows disappear from selectable set

actions.targets: Private/dock-order.json desired baseline
actions.inspect: Current Dock scan
actions.plan: Reusable config without runtime fields
actions.apply: Replace iCloud Private Dock baseline
actions.verify: Resolve locator and read JSON
actions.record: Machine-local Dock scan and iCloud file read-back
actions.backup_rollback: Restore the prior iCloud file version or a verified local copy
actions.interruption: Validate JSON and compare the saved baseline
actions.idempotency: Unchanged Dock produces identical config

actions.targets: Machine-local migration record only
actions.inspect: Tracked component guides for prohibited machine observations
actions.plan: Exact guide, line, code, text, and source hash inventory
actions.apply: Copy findings to machine-local state without editing guides
actions.verify: Read record and compare counts and source hashes
actions.backup_rollback: Record is additive; delete only the generated local record if invalid
actions.interruption: Re-run audit and migration; timestamped records do not overwrite
actions.idempotency: Repeated runs create equivalent timestamped evidence and do not edit sources

actions.targets: Machine-local Homebrew tap/trust and managed npm observation only
actions.inspect: Read tracked source policy and current package-manager JSON
actions.plan: Expected versus observed tap remotes, revisions, trust, and npm versions
actions.apply: Write the read-only observation to machine-local state
actions.verify: Read back the timestamped JSON record and status
actions.backup_rollback: Record is additive and does not mutate package managers
actions.interruption: Rerun inspect; no package-manager state is changed
actions.idempotency: Repeated captures create equivalent timestamped evidence

actions.targets: One machine-local Clean-Mac acceptance session and its sanitized JSON evidence
actions.inspect: Validate contract, clean source commit, eligible-hardware attestation, gate, and evidence
actions.plan: Exact session, gate, outcome, evidence count, and redaction policy
actions.apply: Atomically initialize or update one acceptance session
actions.verify: Read session, sanitized artifact hashes, gate outcome, and history
actions.backup_rollback: Gate history retains prior values; abandon invalid sessions without changing tracked release state
actions.interruption: Temporary session writes do not replace the last valid manifest; retry the same gate
actions.idempotency: Re-recording a gate converges to the requested outcome while preserving history

actions.targets: Status of one complete machine-local Clean-Mac acceptance session
actions.inspect: All 13 gate outcomes, evidence minima, clean worktree, source commit, and contract hash
actions.plan: Exact session eligible for finalization
actions.apply: Mark only that session accepted and explicitly leave publication unauthorized
actions.verify: Read accepted status, final source read-back, and publication_authorized false
actions.backup_rollback: Start a new session if evidence or source is invalid; tracked release status is unchanged
actions.interruption: An unfinalized session remains in_progress and can be rechecked
actions.idempotency: Already-finalized sessions reject a second finalization

actions.targets: One separately named JSON migration output
actions.inspect: Source JSON, registered kind, source version, target version, and output conflict
actions.plan: Exact migrated document with unknown fields preserved
actions.apply: Atomically create a separate non-conflicting output file
actions.verify: Re-read bytes, compare the planned payload, and record SHA-256
actions.record: Command JSON result; the verified output is the migration artifact
actions.backup_rollback: Source is never modified; discard the separate output if it is not adopted
actions.interruption: A temporary sibling never replaces the source; rerun after inspecting the output path
actions.idempotency: An existing byte-identical output is reported unchanged; a different output is refused

actions.targets: One new redacted diagnostic ZIP at the exact reviewed output path
actions.inspect: Controlled checks, versions, public policy hashes, bounded logs, redaction counts, and output conflict
actions.plan: Manifest, file hashes, predicted ZIP hash, failure classes, and redaction preview
actions.apply: Atomically create a new ZIP containing diagnostics, redaction report, and manifest
actions.verify: Reopen ZIP, enforce exact members, verify every manifest hash, and rerun sensitive-pattern checks
actions.record: The verified ZIP plus command JSON result; publication remains unauthorized
actions.backup_rollback: No source is changed; delete the new ZIP if the user rejects it after local review
actions.interruption: A temporary sibling is removed and an existing output is never overwritten
actions.idempotency: Preview is repeatable; export refuses every existing destination instead of replacing it

actions.targets: Frozen iCloud items that are uploaded, conflict-free, unchanged, and locally allocated
actions.inspect: Swift Foundation metadata plus logical and allocated bytes
actions.plan: Plan hash, path fingerprint, inode, cloud state, target capacity, and exact candidate set
actions.apply: Call FileManager.evictUbiquitousItem for one verified action class
actions.verify: Read actual volume free space and iCloud metadata, then require replanning
actions.record: Machine-local storage apply and verify records
actions.backup_rollback: Request iCloud download to restore a local copy
actions.interruption: Stop, rescan cloud state, and freeze a new plan
actions.idempotency: Already-evicted items have no reclaimable local allocation and are rejected

actions.targets: Frozen public-allowlisted caches or dynamically proven Git-ignored build artifacts
actions.inspect: Path fingerprint, inode, allocated bytes, regeneration proof, and for build artifacts Git-ignore, tracked-file, manifest, and active-cwd evidence
actions.plan: Exact unchanged cache candidates and target capacity
actions.apply: Delete only frozen allowlisted caches or Git artifacts whose complete proof still passes
actions.verify: Preserve transaction-scoped reclaimed bytes, record current free space separately, and require replanning
actions.record: Machine-local storage apply and verify records
actions.backup_rollback: No content rollback; supported tools regenerate the cache or build artifact
actions.interruption: Stop, rescan, and never continue against a stale plan
actions.idempotency: Missing, changed, tracked, active, or no-longer-ignored candidates are rejected

actions.targets: Frozen items with an explicit Private archive target
actions.inspect: Source fingerprint and target online, capacity, write, and read-back checks
actions.plan: Exact source, destination, estimated bytes, and target capacity
actions.apply: Copy with metadata, verify counts and logical bytes, then stage source in Trash
actions.verify: Read archive and Trash mapping; staged bytes are not reclaimed
actions.record: Machine-local apply record with archive and recovery paths
actions.backup_rollback: Restore the source from Trash or verified archive before purge
actions.interruption: Preserve both copies and inspect before retry
actions.idempotency: Existing destinations are refused

actions.targets: Frozen unchanged plan-bound user items
actions.inspect: Plan hash, path fingerprint, inode, size, and target capacity
actions.plan: Exact source list and estimated staged bytes
actions.apply: Use FileManager.trashItem and capture resulting paths
actions.verify: Read manifest-bound Trash mappings; reclaimed bytes remain zero
actions.record: Machine-local apply record and Trash restore manifest
actions.backup_rollback: Restore each manifest item before purge
actions.interruption: Inspect source and resulting Trash path before retry
actions.idempotency: Missing or changed sources are rejected

actions.targets: Only unchanged Trash items bound to one prior storage apply manifest
actions.inspect: Prior plan/apply binding, Trash path, inode, and current free space
actions.plan: Exact manifest rows; never the whole Trash
actions.apply: Permanently delete only verified manifest-bound Trash rows
actions.verify: Measure actual volume free-space change and require replanning
actions.backup_rollback: No rollback after purge; Time Machine status is warning evidence only
actions.interruption: Stop and verify every remaining manifest row
actions.idempotency: Missing or changed Trash rows are rejected

actions.targets: Frozen iCloud local-copy restores or manifest-bound staged items
actions.inspect: Cloud or restore mapping and destination conflict
actions.plan: Exact restoration targets
actions.apply: Request iCloud download or restore a manifest-bound item
actions.verify: Read local allocation or restored destination
actions.backup_rollback: Restoration itself is the rollback path
actions.interruption: Inspect provider or source and destination before retry
actions.idempotency: Already-local or restored items converge without overwrite

actions.targets: Reviewed generic decisions promoted to Private intent without machine measurements
actions.inspect: Decision ledger, redaction boundary, and Private conflict
actions.plan: Exact reusable patterns with execution_authorized false
actions.apply: Write only reviewed personal intent to the iCloud Private policy
actions.verify: Reload merged policy and prove execution authorization remains false
actions.backup_rollback: Restore the prior iCloud file version
actions.interruption: Validate both prior and candidate JSON before retry
actions.idempotency: Equivalent Private intent produces unchanged bytes

actions.targets: One export-bound private browser plan in machine-local state
actions.inspect: Explicit Bookmarks-and-Reading-List-only Safari export, artifact hash, private item fingerprints, and requested operations
actions.plan: Exact item-scoped move, merge, archive, or delete proposals with live execution disabled
actions.apply: Atomically create one new machine-local plan with mode 0600; never write Safari
actions.verify: Re-read the plan, validate its schema and payload hash, and retain the export binding
actions.backup_rollback: Source export and Safari remain unchanged; discard the frozen plan if rejected
actions.interruption: A temporary sibling never replaces another plan; rebuild from a fresh export
actions.idempotency: Byte-identical plan is unchanged; a conflicting destination is refused

actions.targets: One new duplicate-only review JSON below Private/browser
actions.inspect: Explicit Safari export, private in-memory normalization, duplicate groups, output boundary, and destination conflict
actions.plan: Duplicate group and item counts only; URLs, titles, item IDs, hashes, and paths stay out of stdout
actions.apply: Atomically create one mode-0600 Private review file without writing Safari
actions.verify: Re-read bytes, validate the registered schema, confirm mode 0600, and keep execution_authorized false
actions.record: The Private review artifact plus a redacted command summary
actions.backup_rollback: Safari and the source export remain unchanged; remove the new review file if rejected
actions.interruption: A temporary sibling is removed and an existing different destination is never overwritten
actions.idempotency: A byte-identical destination is unchanged; a different destination is refused

actions.targets: One source-bound organization JSON below Private/browser
actions.inspect: Explicit Safari export, five-domain taxonomy, path rules, item overrides, duplicate resolutions, title suggestions, expected counts, and destination conflict
actions.plan: Count-only summary for all bookmark and Reading List dispositions; private content remains in memory
actions.apply: Atomically create one mode-0600 Git-ignored Private organization without writing Safari
actions.verify: Re-read bytes, validate Schema and semantic counts, confirm mode 0600, and keep execution_authorized false
actions.record: Private/browser organization plus a redacted command summary
actions.backup_rollback: Safari and source export remain unchanged; remove the new organization file if rejected
actions.interruption: A temporary sibling is removed and an existing different destination is never overwritten
actions.idempotency: Byte-identical output is unchanged; a different existing organization is refused

actions.targets: One immutable hash-named Safari export ZIP below Private/browser/evidence
actions.inspect: Explicit regular-file Safari ZIP, bounded parser result, source hash, date, Git-ignore boundary, and destination conflict
actions.plan: Count-only bookmark, Reading List, item, and byte summary without source path or hash
actions.apply: Atomically copy the original ZIP bytes to a mode-0600 hash-derived Private evidence name
actions.verify: Re-read source and destination hashes, parser artifact binding, byte size, file mode, and Git-ignore boundary
actions.record: Immutable Private evidence ZIP plus a redacted command summary
actions.backup_rollback: Safari and source remain unchanged; remove only the newly imported evidence if rejected
actions.interruption: A temporary sibling is removed; source drift or a different existing destination stops the import
actions.idempotency: An identical destination is unchanged; different bytes at the same destination are refused

actions.targets: One versioned browser organization candidate below Private/browser/versions; never the canonical organization
actions.inspect: Validated old organization, explicit new Safari export, source hashes, semantic fingerprint multiplicity, path-rule applicability, duplicate membership, removed items, and review requirements
actions.plan: Redacted inherited, removed, changed, duplicate, and review counts plus candidate readiness
actions.apply: Atomically write one mode-0600 versioned candidate without changing the canonical organization or Safari
actions.verify: Re-read candidate bytes, validate browser-organization Schema and semantics, mode, source binding, and Git-ignore boundary
actions.record: Versioned Private candidate plus redacted reconciliation summary
actions.backup_rollback: Canonical organization, old candidate, evidence, and Safari remain unchanged; discard the new candidate if rejected
actions.interruption: A temporary sibling is removed and a different versioned destination is never overwritten
actions.idempotency: An identical versioned candidate is unchanged; source drift, unresolved review, or conflicting bytes stop the write

actions.targets: One approved review-only wave below Private/browser/gateway
actions.inspect: Validated public gateway policy, source-bound Private organization, candidate evidence dates, existing host collisions, exact active retirement items, ratio, output boundary, and destination conflict
actions.plan: Redacted new-source, retirement, projected-count, and subdomain summary; private titles, URLs, item IDs, fingerprints, and hashes stay out of stdout
actions.apply: Atomically create one mode-0600 Git-ignored Private wave ledger without changing Safari
actions.verify: Re-read canonical bytes, validate the registered Schema, file mode, source binding, ratio, and execution_authorized false
actions.record: Private gateway wave plus redacted command summary
actions.backup_rollback: Organization and Safari remain unchanged; discard the wave ledger before any separately authorized migration
actions.interruption: A temporary sibling is removed and a different existing destination is never overwritten
actions.idempotency: An identical destination is unchanged; different bytes at the destination are refused

actions.targets: One final source-bound Safari gateway pilot below Private/browser/gateway
actions.inspect: Validated organization and immutable prior wave, exact 10 exchange groups, 20 retirement bindings, target directories, checkpoint counts, Git-ignore boundary, and destination conflict
actions.plan: Aggregate group, new-source, archive, staged-removal, untouched-item, and checkpoint counts; private titles, URLs, paths, item IDs, fingerprints, and hashes stay out of stdout
actions.apply: Atomically create one mode-0600 Git-ignored Private pilot ledger; never write Safari or authorize purge
actions.verify: Re-read canonical bytes, validate Schema and semantic manifests, mode 0600, source and superseded-wave binding, exact counts, and both execution flags false
actions.record: Private pilot ledger plus a redacted command summary
actions.backup_rollback: Organization, old wave, evidence, and Safari remain unchanged; discard the pilot before manual execution if rejected
actions.interruption: A temporary sibling is removed and a different existing destination is never overwritten
actions.idempotency: An identical destination is unchanged; different bytes at the destination are refused

actions.targets: One bounded convergence ledger below Private/browser/gateway
actions.inspect: Validated organization and pilot bindings, exact legacy item fingerprints, current trial evidence, per-subdomain quotas, Reading List exclusion, and output conflict
actions.plan: Aggregate retained, trial, excluded, archive, delete, promotion, and Reading List counts only

actions.verify: Re-read bytes, validate Schema and reviewed 90-110-source target, mode 0600, source bindings, and all authority flags false

actions.backup_rollback: Organization, pilot, evidence, and Safari remain unchanged; discard the ledger before package generation

actions.idempotency: An identical destination is unchanged; different bytes are refused

actions.targets: One convergence-bound complete display order below Private/browser/gateway
actions.inspect: Frozen convergence hash, all active source IDs, 15 folder bindings, explicit tiers, ranks, pin limit, Git-ignore boundary, and destination conflict

actions.verify: Re-read bytes, validate Schema, hash binding, exact source coverage, contiguous ranks, tier blocks, pin limits, mode, and both authority flags false

actions.backup_rollback: Convergence ledger, prior package, and Safari remain unchanged; discard the order before package generation

actions.inspect: Frozen convergence and display-order Schemas, exact hash binding, complete ranked source coverage, one-level subdomain folders, Reading List exclusion, Git-ignore boundary, and destination conflict
actions.plan: Aggregate bookmark, Reading List, target-folder, folder-depth, and order-verification fields only

actions.verify: Parse the written HTML and compare every URL, title, one-level folder, item sequence, and count with the frozen ledgers
